_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Octail's own, following black-mesa.json and no-more-room-in-hell.json, with LinuxGSM's zpsserver settings (MIT licence) for the app, game folder and default map and the pelican-eggs steamcmd base script (games-steamcmd, MIT licence), on Octail's source image (32-bit libraries). App 17505 (anonymous SteamCMD, Linux build) with the game folder (zps) fixed. The Linux server segfaults right after loading the VPK hashes when it runs on the image's libraries alone (node1, 2026-10-13; the same with LinuxGSM on Ubuntu 22.04), and the game's developers answer that it must run inside Valve's Steam Runtime: the install adds the scout runtime (one pinned snapshot, SHA-256 checked, 226 MB on the server's disk) and the start line runs srcds_run through steam-runtime/run.sh, which puts the runtime's libraries after the host's; a server installed before this fix says so at start and runs without it until it is reinstalled. Octail adds the zombie-panic-source tags, Source RCON on the game port with a generated password hidden from customers, the Players tab (source preset) and the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, a max players setting (-maxplayers), an optional Game Server Login Token (+sv_setsteamaccount only when one is set), start detection by the Steam ID line or the Steam connection line with the UDP game port as a fallback (ready after 60 s), generic UDP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server), the say broadcast, the update before start (AUTO_UPDATE, on by default), an optional beta branch, a starter server.cfg, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration"; the SteamCMD download times out and retries instead of hanging the install.
name: Zombie Panic! Source
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Zombie Panic! Source is a free cooperative survival-horror shooter on the Source engine: survivors against the undead in Survival, Objective and Hardcore modes.

startup_commands.Default: RT=; [ -x steam-runtime/run.sh ] && RT=./steam-runtime/run.sh || echo "octail: steam-runtime/run.sh is missing (reinstall the server to add the Steam Runtime); starting without it."; $RT ./srcds_run -game zps -console -port {{SERVER_PORT}} +ip 0.0.0.0 +map {{SRCDS_MAP}} -maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +rcon_password "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}" -strictportbind -norestart $( [ -z "${STEAM_ACC}" ] || printf %s "+sv_setsteamaccount ${STEAM_ACC}" )

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Zombie Panic! Source Dedicated Server (app 17505) Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Based on the pelican-eggs steamcmd base script (games-steamcmd, MIT licence).
#
# Variables
# SRCDS_APPID - 17505 (Zombie Panic! Source Dedicated Server, anonymous)
# SRCDS_BETAID - an optional beta branch

## The Zombie Panic! Source dedicated server installs anonymously
STEAM_USER=anonymous

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
## Octail: time out and retry instead of hanging the install when the download stalls
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Could not download SteamCMD; try reinstalling."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
beta=()
[[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || beta=(-beta "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "${STEAM_USER}" +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" "${beta[@]}" validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/srcds_run" || ! -d "/mnt/server/zps" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Zombie Panic! Source dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## Octail: the Linux server crashes at start (a segmentation fault right after it loads the VPK hashes) unless it runs
## inside Valve's Steam Runtime, as the game's developers advise; the start line runs srcds_run through
## steam-runtime/run.sh. The scout runtime, pinned to one snapshot (63 MB, 226 MB unpacked, on the server's disk) and
## checked against its SHA-256; a newer snapshot needs both updated here. Kept on a reinstall when it is that version.
STEAM_RUNTIME_VERSION=1.0.20260714.251828
STEAM_RUNTIME_SHA256=b32344c666d3189d0254587a797c404a4b959c2f245b4a56fc32b841e9c05ff7
cd /mnt/server || exit 1
if [[ "$(cat steam-runtime/version.txt 2> /dev/null)" != "steam-runtime_${STEAM_RUNTIME_VERSION}" ]]; then
    echo "Downloading the Steam Runtime ${STEAM_RUNTIME_VERSION}"
    curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 900 --retry 3 -o steam-runtime.tar.xz "https://repo.steampowered.com/steamrt-images-scout/snapshots/${STEAM_RUNTIME_VERSION}/steam-runtime.tar.xz" || { echo "Could not download the Steam Runtime; try reinstalling."; exit 1; }
    echo "${STEAM_RUNTIME_SHA256}  steam-runtime.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c --quiet - || { rm -f steam-runtime.tar.xz; echo "The Steam Runtime download doesn't match its SHA-256; try reinstalling."; exit 1; }
    rm -rf steam-runtime
    tar -xJf steam-runtime.tar.xz || { rm -f steam-runtime.tar.xz; echo "Could not unpack the Steam Runtime; try reinstalling."; exit 1; }
    rm -f steam-runtime.tar.xz
fi
if [[ ! -x steam-runtime/run.sh ]]; then
    echo -e "\nThe Steam Runtime is missing after unpacking it (steam-runtime/run.sh); try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## A server.cfg to start from; an existing one is kept
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/zps/cfg/server.cfg" ]]; then
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/zps/cfg
    printf '%s\n' 'hostname "Zombie Panic! Source server on Octail"' 'sv_password ""' 'sv_lan 0' > /mnt/server/zps/cfg/server.cfg
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: The Steam app id of the Zombie Panic! Source Dedicated Server.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The first map, for example zps_deadend; any map in zps/maps/ works.

variables.name: Steam Game Server Login Token
variables.description: Optional: a Steam Game Server Login Token (app id 17500, the Zombie Panic! Source game) so the server keeps the same Steam ID and shows in the server list reliably. Generate one at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Source RCON password. Octail generates one when the server is created, keeps it from customers and sends console commands over RCON.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: An optional Steam beta branch; empty for the public build. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Auto-update server
variables.description: Check for a server update with SteamCMD at every start (1 on, 0 off).
